title: Break Up
overview: The war with Tenjiku reaches a deadly conclusion. Takemichi takes this chance to tell Mikey he is a Time Leaper, and explains everything he has been through. After hearing the truth, Mikey announces that the Tokyo Manji Gang is disbanding. The legendary organization that once stood at the top of Japan has come to an end.

title: Be Left Behind the Times
overview: Following Tokyo Manji Gang's disbandment, Takemichi is about to return to his original timeline, but a forgotten Valentine's gift for Hina leads to an unexpected proposal. After burying a time capsule with his comrades and promising to meet again in 12 years, Takemichi makes a Time Leap. He arrives in a world where all his friends are living happily, but Mikey is nowhere to be found.
